name: Create Custom Dashboard
description: Build a personalized dashboard with widgets and metrics

steps.title: Access Dashboard Builder
steps.description: Click on the Dashboards menu and select 'Create New Dashboard'.

steps.title: Name Your Dashboard
steps.description: Enter a descriptive name for your dashboard.

steps.title: Add Widgets
steps.description: Click the 'Add Widget' button and select from available widget types.

steps.title: Configure Widget Settings
steps.description: Set up each widget with the appropriate data sources and display options.

steps.title: Arrange Layout
steps.description: Drag and drop widgets to arrange them in your preferred layout.

steps.title: Save Dashboard
steps.description: Click Save to store your dashboard configuration.
